description_en: Retrieves encrypted zero-trust temporary credentials by role for authorized partners. Each call returns a temporary AccessKey ID, AccessKey secret, and security token
description_zh: 为已授权的合作伙伴按角色获取加密的零信任临时凭证。每次调用返回一组临时访问密钥 ID、访问密钥 Secret 和安全令牌
name: GetAklessTmpIdentityForPartner

parameters.help_en: The zero-trust role code, which is case-sensitive. The default code ai-website-clouddream-oem corresponds to the OEM role, and ai-website-clouddream-oem-provider corresponds to the OEM service provider role. Specify one code per request
parameters.help_zh: 零信任角色编码，区分大小写。默认编码 ai-website-clouddream-oem 对应 OEM 角色，ai-website-clouddream-oem-provider 对应 OEM 服务提供方角色。每次请求填写一个编码
parameters.name: role_code

parameters.help_en: The source system code for the call. This parameter is optional. This field is reserved for future extensions. Currently, the credential retrieval role is selected based on RoleCode
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源系统编码，可省略。该字段用于后续扩展，当前按 RoleCode 选择取证角色
parameters.name: app_code

Data.description_en: The business response data. If the call is successful, this field contains the temporary credentials for the selected zero-trust role
Data.description_zh: 业务响应数据。成功时包含所选零信任角色的临时凭证

Credentials.description_en: The ciphertext strings of the three temporary credentials returned in the same call. Decrypt them separately and use them as a set
Credentials.description_zh: 同一次调用返回的三项临时凭证密文。分别解密后配套使用

EncryptedAccessKeyId.description_en: The ciphertext of the temporary AccessKey ID. Decode the string by using standard Base64, take the first 16 bytes as the initialization vector, and decrypt the remaining bytes by using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding
EncryptedAccessKeyId.description_zh: 临时访问密钥 ID 的密文。使用标准 Base64 解码，取前 16 字节作为初始向量，使用 AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding 解密余下字节

EncryptedAccessKeySecret.description_en: The ciphertext of the temporary AccessKey secret. Decode the string by using standard Base64, take the first 16 bytes as the initialization vector, and decrypt the remaining bytes by using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding
EncryptedAccessKeySecret.description_zh: 临时访问密钥 Secret 的密文。使用标准 Base64 解码，取前 16 字节作为初始向量，使用 AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding 解密余下字节

EncryptedSecurityToken.description_en: The ciphertext of the temporary security token. Decode the string by using standard Base64, take the first 16 bytes as the initialization vector, and decrypt the remaining bytes by using AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding
EncryptedSecurityToken.description_zh: 临时安全令牌的密文。使用标准 Base64 解码，取前 16 字节作为初始向量，使用 AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding 解密余下字节

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code. If the call fails, you can identify the cause of the failure by using this code in combination with the Code in the gateway response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 业务错误码。调用失败时，可结合网关响应中的 Code 定位失败原因

ErrorMsg.description_en: The business error message. If the call fails, you can troubleshoot the issue by using this message in combination with the Message and request ID in the gateway response
ErrorMsg.description_zh: 业务错误说明。调用失败时，可结合网关响应中的 Message 和请求 ID 排查

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the current call. Provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的请求 ID。排查问题时提供此值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the business call is successful. A value of true indicates that you can read Data.Credentials. A value of false indicates that the credential retrieval failed
Success.description_zh: 业务调用是否成功。值为 true 时可读取 Data.Credentials。值为 false 时表示取证失败
